test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following books has the author described the horrors of the holocaust and the Second World War?

options.text: The Diary of a young girl
I know why the caged bird sings

solution:
The Correct answer is __**The Diary of a Young Girl**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Diary of a Young Girl** was written by **Anne Frank**, a Jewish teenager.
 
• The book is a personal diary that documents Anne Frank's experiences hiding from the Nazis during **World War II**.
 
• Anne Frank and her family went into hiding in a secret annex in Amsterdam during the **Nazi occupation of the Netherlands**.
 
• The diary reveals the horrors of the **Holocaust**, including the fear, deprivation, and loss faced by Jewish families.
 
• It provides a unique perspective on the impact of **anti-Semitism** and the atrocities committed during the **Second World War**.
 
• The diary was published posthumously by Anne's father, **Otto Frank**, and has since become a powerful account of the Holocaust.
 
• The book emphasizes themes of **hope, resilience, and the human spirit** in the face of unimaginable adversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings**__

 __
 
• This book is an autobiography by **Maya Angelou**.
 
• It focuses on themes of **racism, identity, and resilience** in the African-American community.
 
• While it is an important work, it does not document the Holocaust or World War II.
 
• Maya Angelou's writing is celebrated for its exploration of **race and social issues** in the United States.
 
 
 
• **Dreams from My Father**__
 __
 
• Written by **Barack Obama**, this book is a memoir about his early life and his journey of self-discovery.
 
• The book focuses on themes of **race, identity, and family**, and does not address the Holocaust or World War II.
 
• It provides insights into Obama's multicultural heritage and personal experiences that shaped his worldview.
 
 
 
• **Long Walk to Freedom**__
 
 
• Authored by **Nelson Mandela**, this autobiography recounts his struggle against **apartheid in South Africa**.
 
• The book focuses on Mandela's political activism, imprisonment, and eventual triumph in abolishing apartheid.
 
• It does not address the Holocaust or World War II.
